WITH RECURSIVE doomed_seed AS ( SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m LEFT JOIN portal_menu p ON m.parent_id = p.id WHERE lower(m.name) = 'sys.nav.portal.studiosemanticsubjects' OR (m.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(m.metadata) LIKE '%studiosemanticsubjects%') OR (m.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(m.metadata) LIKE '%/modeling/semantic/subjects%') OR ( lower(m.path) IN ('subjects', 'studio/metric-modeling/subjects') AND ( lower(p.name) = 'sys.nav.portal.studiometricmodeling' OR lower(p.path) = 'metric-modeling' OR (p.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(p.metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"studio"%') ) ) ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_seed UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM portal_menu child JOIN doomed parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id ) DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility v WHERE v.menu_id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
WITH RECURSIVE doomed_seed AS ( SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m LEFT JOIN portal_menu p ON m.parent_id = p.id WHERE lower(m.name) = 'sys.nav.portal.studiosemanticsubjects' OR (m.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(m.metadata) LIKE '%studiosemanticsubjects%') OR (m.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(m.metadata) LIKE '%/modeling/semantic/subjects%') OR ( lower(m.path) IN ('subjects', 'studio/metric-modeling/subjects') AND ( lower(p.name) = 'sys.nav.portal.studiometricmodeling' OR lower(p.path) = 'metric-modeling' OR (p.metadata IS NOT NULL AND lower(p.metadata) LIKE '%"sectionkey":"studio"%') ) ) ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_seed UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM portal_menu child JOIN doomed parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id ) DELETE FROM portal_menu m WHERE m.id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
